name: Mehdipatnam Junction
reasons: High-speed traffic merging from multiple directions
Poor visibility at night due to inadequate street lighting
Heavy pedestrian crossing without proper zebra crossings
safety_measures: Reduce speed to 30 km/h when approaching
Use extreme caution during peak hours (8-10 AM, 6-8 PM)
Watch for pedestrians crossing unexpectedly
Avoid overtaking near the junction

name: Outer Ring Road Near TSPA
reasons: Heavy truck traffic leading to brake failures
Lack of median barriers in certain sections
Stray animals frequently crossing the road
safety_measures: Maintain speed under 60 km/h in marked zones
Keep safe distance from trucks (minimum 50 meters)
Use high beam only when no oncoming traffic
Stay alert for animals especially at dawn/dusk

name: Gachibowli Flyover
reasons: Sudden braking by vehicles at toll plaza
safety_measures: Reduce speed to 40 km/h on flyover
Avoid sudden lane changes
Maintain extra distance during rain
Use turn signals well in advance

name: Uppal X Road
reasons: Encroachment by street vendors reducing visibility
Frequent power cuts disabling traffic signals
safety_measures: Approach at crawling speed (15-20 km/h)
Check all sides before entering intersection
Honk before crossing to alert other vehicles
Never assume right of way

name: Miyapur Metro Station Road
reasons: Heavy pedestrian footfall from metro station
safety_measures: Drive at 25 km/h maximum near metro entry
Watch for pedestrians stepping onto road suddenly
Avoid this route during heavy rain
Use horn sparingly to avoid startling pedestrians

name: LB Nagar Flyover Exit
reasons: Sharp descent leading to brake overheating
safety_measures: Use engine braking on descent
Check brakes before entering flyover
Avoid riding on oil patches (dark spots on road)
Turn on headlights even during day

name: Shamshabad Airport Road - Toll Plaza
reasons: Sudden speed reduction from 80 to 20 km/h
safety_measures: Start braking 500 meters before toll plaza
Use hazard lights when slowing down
Take a break every 2 hours if tired
Reduce speed to 40 km/h in fog

name: Jubilee Hills Check Post
reasons: Luxury cars speeding in residential area
Poor road markings for lane guidance
safety_measures: Obey 30 km/h speed limit strictly
Be prepared to stop for police checks
Extra caution during school hours (8-9 AM, 3-4 PM)
Yield to pedestrians at all times
